system: Elevate X AI Feature 3 — 6-Layer Hybrid Semantic Evidence Matcher

layers.name: Exact Phrase Matching
layers.target: Raw technical tokens and compound terms

layers.name: Normalized Lexical Matching
layers.mechanism: Case folding, whitespace collapse, punctuation stripping
layers.target: Varied casing and punctuation (e.g. node.js vs nodejs, c++ vs cpp)

layers.name: Technical Entity Alias Expansion
layers.mechanism: Curated bidirectional technical alias ontology (32 major technical taxonomy families)
layers.target: Standard industry aliases (e.g., LLM -> Large Language Model, Generative AI; RAG -> Retrieval Augmented Generation)

layers.name: Pretrained DistilBERT Semantic Embedding Cosine Similarity
layers.target: Full responsibility statements, contextual experience bullets, and soft qualifications

layers.name: Source Evidence Retrieval & Provenance Tagging
layers.mechanism: Section-specific citation formatting ([Technical Skill], [Project Evidence], [Work Experience], [Coursework Evidence], [Certification Evidence])
layers.target: Every match references authentic extracted candidate text lines

layers.name: Deterministic 5-State Requirement Classification & Academic Distinction
layers.coursework_rule: Candidate evidence found solely in academic coursework is strictly tagged as [Coursework Evidence] and classified as partially_supported (score 0.65) to separate commercial work experience from coursework.

underlying_models.section_classifier_model: ResumeSectionNeuralClassifier (Linear(10000, 256) -> ReLU -> Dropout -> Linear(256, 128) -> ReLU -> Dropout -> Linear(128, 6))
